name: DEPO Ventures
decision_note: Prague inception/pre-seed fund manager (angel funds AF II/AF III, fourth fund targeting EUR 30m; DEPO Ventures One SCSp selected by NRI in Aug 2026 with a CZK 94m commitment); led Tapaya's pre-seed in April 2026 and co-invested in WanderWallet (March 2026) and Kardi AI (April 2025).

evidence.quote: Fueling inception & pre-seed companies strengthening Europe’s critical infrastructure
With its current fund, it focuses on strategic technologies in areas such as defense, space, and fintech.
Nedávno jste otevřeli váš čtvrtý fond, který cílí na částku 30 milionů eur.
Ano, do půl milionu eur maximálně.
Investiční kolo vedl tuzemský fond Depo Ventures společně s britským Passion Capital, připojil se také lotyšský BADideas.fund.
Prostředky mu poskytl fond BD Partners, který založili bývalí akcionáři PPF Ladislav Bartoníček a Jean-Pascal Duvieusart, a andělský fond Depo Ventures.
Od stávajících investorů BrightCap Ventures, Depo Ventures a Garage Angels a nově také od Lumus Investment Collective i nejmenovaného českého andělského investora získal celkem 28 milionů korun.
DEPO creates DEPO Angels as a Business Angel Network
Vybraným finančním zprostředkovatelem se stal fond DEPO Ventures One SCSp, spravovaný lucemburským fondem rizikového kapitálu DEPO Ventures Sàrl, podporujícím rozvoj startupů.
Do vybraného fondu vstupuje s kapitálovou investicí 94 milionů Kč.

National Development Investment, a subsidiary of the Czech National Development Bank, has committed €3.8 million to the fund, with the investment potentially increasing to €5.8 million subject to conditions related to private capital and investment deployment.
Zajímavostí je, že právě tento fond Depo Ventures představilo na jaře letošního roku a uzavřelo jej na konci srpna s objemem 55 milionů korun.

Depo Ventures stojí za prvním andělským fondem svého druhu v Česku, když před šesti lety od investorů v podobě zkušených manažerů a dalších zakladatelů firem sesbírali 35 milionů korun a ty postupně pod názvem Grouport Ventures investovali do čtrnácti startupů

analyst_notes: Model: DEPO runs pooled early-stage funds (DEPO VENTURES AF II. and AF III., both 'osoba rizikového kapitálu' s.r.o.; the e15 interview of 2026-04-11 says a fourth and largest fund targeting EUR 30m was recently opened, 'technically the fourth, from a VC point of view the second') and, separately, the DEPO Angels business angel network (membership terms, e11). Primary type vc (dominant activity is fund investing), secondary angel_network. CzechCrunch calls it an 'andělský fond' (angel fund) and in one 2025 article a 'syndikát'. Capital: no closed fund size or AUM found - the EUR 30m is a target, recorded under funds (event 'target', dated by the interview) not as capital; the homepage shows '9M€ capital deployed' (cumulative deployed, not a fund size); the CVCA profile (self-reported, 2020) said EUR 5.5m AUM. Ticket EUR 250-500k stated on the homepage, consistent with e15 'up to half a million euros'; CVCA 2020 said EUR 50-300k (superseded). Sectors as stated on the homepage: defence, space (mapped to deeptech_hardware), fintech, Industry 4.0 (industrial_manufacturing), energy. Investments: Tapaya EUR 1m pre-seed co-led with Passion Capital; WanderWallet CZK 10.5m pre-seed with BD Partners (DEPO's own page says EUR 430K; company operates in Latin America, founder Czech, HQ country not stated so left null); Kardi AI CZK 28m third round from existing investors incl. DEPO (round type not stated). DEPO's own news page also reports a 2026 investment in Prague-based Plexo (undated page, not used as activity evidence). Fund vehicle for the fourth fund not found in ARES. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: added the newer fund event - National Development Investment (NRI, subsidiary of the Czech National Development Bank) selected DEPO Ventures One SCSp, managed by the Luxembourg DEPO Ventures Sàrl, as the intermediary of its 'Fond Ukrajina' programme (startups from Ukraine, Moldova and Georgia expanding to Czechia) and enters with a CZK 94m capital investment, possibly increased to CZK 141m (NRB release published on BusinessInfo.cz 2026-08-26, e13/e14); Vestbee (2026-10-05, e15) reports the same commitment as EUR 3.8m (up to EUR 5.8m). Recorded as a commitment of CZK 94m dated 2026-08-26 (the earliest source; Vestbee's 2026-10-05 is a later report). The two Luxembourg entities were added as legal entities (no registry IDs looked up). Whether DEPO Ventures One SCSp is the same vehicle as the EUR 30m-target fourth fund is not stated; capital stays not_disclosed because no close has been published and an LP commitment alone is not a fund size.] [revision 2026-10-25 after review round 2: capital changed from not_disclosed to CZK 94m interim_close as of 2026-08-26 (e13/e14), following the revised capital-basis rule. The amount is a single LP commitment - NRI's CZK 94m capital investment into DEPO Ventures One SCSp, the newest DEPO vehicle, which is still raising (NRI may increase to CZK 141m if the required private capital is secured) - and it is the only public committed amount for that fund; it is not a close announced by DEPO and not a fund size. Whether DEPO Ventures One SCSp is the EUR 30m-target fourth fund or a separate Fond Ukrajina vehicle is still not stated (Vestbee calls it 'a new fund'). The previous sentence saying capital stays not_disclosed is superseded. Older public fund sizes were added as fund events: Andělský fond II (Depo Angels Fund II, presumably the vehicle DEPO VENTURES AF II.) was presented in spring 2022 and closed at the end of August 2022 at CZK 55m, CZK 10m above plan (CzechCrunch 2022-10-07, e16; month-only date recorded as 2022-08-01) - recorded as a fund event rather than as capital because it is not the newest fund; the first angel fund, Grouport Ventures, raised CZK 35m about six years before January 2022 (CzechCrunch 2022-01-25, e17; no close date given, event_date null). The third angel fund (opened October 2022 with a CZK 500m target) has no published close.]
